# 安全问题反馈

针对本 fork 的安全问题，请先发不含利用细节和敏感数据的 issue 询问私密报告方式。当前仓库未启用 GitHub 私密漏洞报告；若以后启用，可改用 Security 页面中的私密报告入口。

上游 fzf 本身的漏洞请遵循[上游报告政策](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf/blob/bf4869b7fa7748d973eeb414da4dde0d7fe4cd3c/SECURITY.md)。其中的联系方式和响应承诺属于上游。

# Reporting security issues

For issues specific to this fork, open an issue requesting a private reporting channel without including exploit details or sensitive data. GitHub private vulnerability reporting is currently disabled for this repository. If enabled later, use the private reporting option on its Security page.

For vulnerabilities in upstream fzf, follow the [upstream reporting policy](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf/blob/bf4869b7fa7748d973eeb414da4dde0d7fe4cd3c/SECURITY.md). Its contact details and response commitments belong to upstream.
